def: Nobach, the name of an Israelite, and of a place East of the Jordan

occurrences.text: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
